_comment: Model manifest schema for strix-alloy. Describes a target+optional-draft selection so a package can be validated without downloading anything. Models are NEVER bundled - they stay on the user's disk.

selected.distinctive: All tensors IQ4_NL, ~4.52 bpw. Measured fastest for this engine's IQ4_NL kernel paths; see docs/benchmarks/engine-comparison.md.

draft.note: Official shared MTP sidecar; borrows the trunk's embedding and output head. Verified byte-identical and size-identical to the publisher artifact.

alternativesConsidered.name: UD-IQ4_XS (unsloth)
alternativesConsidered.verdict: rejected for speed on this engine; 4.52 bpw PROJFIX measured faster despite being larger

validation.shardSetComplete: required - the launcher checks the -of-NNNNN total
validation.serialFallback: permitted and logged; the launcher never silently changes inference mode
